notes: Fixed title drag/resize interaction broken after multi-line title changes. Root cause: _hitTestTitle() in TitleInteraction.js computed the title box position using simplified logic that diverged from TitleRenderer.render() in two ways: (1) X position in legacy mode (no custom position/width) — hit test centered the box width, but renderer centered the text width, creating a PADDING*2 offset between clickable area and rendered area; (2) Y position for multi-line titles — hit test used single-line formula (titleBoxY - fontSize - 12) but renderer used computeMultiLineBounds.y which accounts for multi-line height, making the top line of multi-line titles unclickable. Fix: rewrote _hitTestTitle to use the same three-mode X position logic as the renderer (custom position, custom width centered, legacy text-centered with bgX offset) and use bounds.y for box top. Also fixed _onPointerDown dragStartBoxX computation to match, preventing visual jump on first drag from legacy mode. Added 4 tests: legacy center hit, legacy left hit, multi-line top line hit, legacy drag no-jump. All 1,337 tests pass (38 TitleInteraction tests, up from 34).
